title: HydraLLM: Adaptive Width Slicing for Elastic Text and Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.23455v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs and LVLMs are increasingly deployed across heterogeneous hardware, ranging from data-center GPUs to resource-constrained edge devices. Their fixed-size architectures limit the ability to reuse a single model across deployment settings with different compute, latency, and model-size targets. We introduce HydraLLM, an elastic MQA-based architecture. Its number of active attention heads determines the effective widths of the embeddings, attention projections, feed-forward layers, and the output head, forming a nested family of subnetworks within a single parameter set. We introduce a static-to-elastic conversion pipeline that, starting from a pre-trained model checkpoint, includes importance-driven weight reordering and stochastic subnetwork training with knowledge distillation. translated_title: HydraLLM：面向弹性文本与视觉-语言模型的自适应宽度切分
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）和大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）正日益部署在从数据中心GPU到资源受限边缘设备的异构硬件上。其固定规模的架构限制了单一模型在不同计算、延迟和模型大小需求的部署环境中复用的能力。我们提出HydraLLM，一种基于弹性MQA（多查询注意力）的架构。其激活的注意力头数量决定了嵌入层、注意力投影、前馈层和输出头的有效宽度，从而在单一参数集内形成一个嵌套的子网络家族。我们引入了一套从静态到弹性的转换流水线，从预训练模型检查点出发，包含基于重要性的权重重排序以及结合知识蒸馏的随机子网络训练。我们通过一个弹性投影模块将该原则扩展到多模态推理，该模块的输出宽度跟随激活的文本宽度。HydraLLM覆盖了更广泛的……
tldr: 提出HydraLLM弹性架构，通过激活注意力头数量动态调整模型各层宽度，使单一参数集能够适配从数据中心GPU到边缘设备的多种部署场景，并通过弹性投影模块将该能力扩展到视觉-语言多模态推理。
en_tdlr: HydraLLM is an elastic MQA-based architecture that adaptively slices model width by the number of active attention heads, allowing a single parameter set to serve diverse deployment scenarios from data-center GPUs to edge devices, and extends this elasticity to vision-language multimodal inference.
